benefits.name: Bilt Travel Hotel Credit
benefits.description: $200 statement credit issued twice per year (total $400 annually) for qualifying hotel bookings made through the Bilt Travel Portal.

benefits.name: Bilt Cash
benefits.description: $200 of Bilt Cash awarded annually. Up to $100 of unused Bilt Cash rolls over into the next calendar year.

multipliers.notes: Earn points on rent with no fee (up to 100k points/year)
